title: Aasish's Birthday Hunt
giveUpMessages: Let's not make your brain work too hard on your birthday. Here's the answer.
Birthday mercy rule activated. Here's the answer.
Five tries, zero points. Lucky for you, it's your birthday.
Aileen saw that coming. Here you go.
Okay, birthday boy, we'll let this one slide.

welcome.heading: Happy birthday, Aasish
welcome.text:
Today you're going on an adventure through places that tell pieces of your story.

At every stop, someone who loves you has recorded your next clue. Solve it, find your way there, and the next one unlocks.

stops.name: Gage Park
stops.clue:
Your journey begins somewhere surrounded by green,
A place where Hamilton's beauty can be seen.
Before you chase the city far and wide,
Find the park where the next clue likes to hide.
stops.address: Gage Park, 1000 Main St E, Hamilton, ON

stops.name: Tim Hortons Field
stops.clue:
You've found the first piece, but don't celebrate yet.
Your next destination is where crowds don't forget.
Where cheers get loud and the home team plays,
Head toward the field where Hamilton spends its days.
stops.address: Tim Hortons Field, 64 Melrose Ave N, Hamilton, ON

stops.name: Cowabunga Pizzeria
stops.clue:
Enough with the sports, now it's time to eat.
Your next destination involves something cheesy and neat.
Think Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles,
Think pizza,
And think about where we'd go when hunger strikes.

stops.name: Hamilton Mountain Lookout
stops.clue:
You've filled your stomach, now raise your eyes.
Your next destination gives you quite the prize.
Don't look for a building, don't look for a door.
Find the place where Hamilton stretches below you once more.
stops.address: Sam Lawrence Park, 255 Concession St, Hamilton, ON

stops.name: Burlington Beach
stops.clue:
You've looked down upon the city.
Now it's time to find the water.
Follow the road toward a place
Where Hamilton meets the lake.
Bring your sunglasses. 🌊

stops.name: McMaster University
stops.clue:
From waves to books, from sand to school,
Your next destination played by a different rule.
Find the place where minds get tested,
And memories were made between lectures and lessons.
stops.address: McMaster University, 1280 Main St W, Hamilton, ON

stops.name: Cootes Paradise
stops.clue:
You don't need a classroom for your next adventure.
Leave the buildings behind.
Find the paradise that hides behind the place you just visited.

stops.name: Dundas Peak
stops.clue:
You've wandered through paradise.
Now it's time to climb.
Your next destination rewards those
Who are willing to go a little higher.
Find the peak.

stops.name: Tiffany Falls
stops.clue:
You climbed to the top.
Now follow the sound of falling water.
Your next destination isn't something you can buy,
but something you can hear before you see.
stops.address: Tiffany Falls Conservation Area, Ancaster, ON

stops.name: Jackson Square
stops.clue:
Enough trees.
Enough hiking.
Enough pretending we're outdoorsy. 😂
It's time to return to the city.
Find one of Hamilton's most recognizable downtown landmarks.
stops.address: Jackson Square, 2 King St W, Hamilton, ON

stops.name: FirstOntario Concert Hall
stops.clue:
From shopping to shouting.
Your next stop is where thousands gather,
where the lights go down,
the crowd gets loud,
and something is always happening on the floor.
stops.address: FirstOntario Concert Hall, 1 Summers Ln, Hamilton, ON

stops.name: Tamasha
stops.clue:
Hamilton was only the beginning.
Now we're going somewhere with a few more skyscrapers.
Your next clues are connected to a different chapter of your story.
Follow the road east.
Your first stop is somewhere you can eat.

stops.name: Finch Station
stops.clue:
Your last stop had food, music and a little bit of flair.
Now head somewhere where thousands of people pass through every day.
You don't need a car to get there.
Find the station at the end of this clue.

stops.name: Yonge & Finch
stops.clue:
You've found the station.
But stations aren't usually where memories begin.
Walk a little beyond it.
Find the intersection that takes you closer
to the neighbourhood that once felt like home.
stops.address: Yonge St & Finch Ave W, Toronto, ON

stops.name: Nantha's
stops.clue:
You've reached a place that once meant something.
But memories can make you hungry.
Your next destination is known for something cold, sweet and tropical.
Find the place where the mango comes to the rescue. 🥭

stops.name: Wow Wings
stops.clue:
Sweet was easy.
Now we need something with a little more kick.
Your next destination has wings,
but you're not looking for the kind that can fly.
stops.address: WOW! Wing House, 9587 Weston Rd, Woodbridge, ON

stops.name: Vaughan Mills
stops.clue:
One final destination before we head home.
You won't find just one store here.
In fact, you'll find hundreds.
Find the giant shopping destination in Vaughan.
stops.address: Vaughan Mills, 1 Bass Pro Mills Dr, Vaughan, ON

stops.name: Home
stops.clue:
You've chased clues through Hamilton.
You've revisited old places.
You've eaten, explored, climbed, walked and probably complained about driving. 😂

But every adventure needs somewhere to end.
You've spent today visiting places that tell pieces of your story.
Now there's only one place left to find.

Go back to where we started. ❤️
